_about: Task 51: independent Document QA / document-quiz evaluation set. All documents are fictional so the model cannot answer from pretrained knowledge. 'keywords' must ALL appear (case-insensitive) in a correct answer; 'page' is the page the fact is on. Unanswerable questions (expect=abstain) include facts adjacent to the document's subject and common-knowledge facts the document does not state.

Harbor Point Robotics Club Handbook
Membership
Annual membership dues are $35 per semester. The club meets every Thursday at 6:30 pm in Room E214 of the Engineering Annex. The club was founded in 2009 by Professor Ilsa Varga.

Competition
The club competes in the Gulf Coast BotBattle every April. Competition robots must weigh no more than 15 kg. The build season lasts ten weeks, and the lead captain is elected each September.

Safety Rules
Soldering is only permitted when the safety officer is present. Lithium batteries must be stored in fireproof cabinet B. Any injury must be reported to the faculty advisor within 24 hours.

pages:
Willow Creek Shuttle Service Guide
Routes
The Blue Line campus loop runs every 12 minutes from 7 am to 10 pm. The Red Line runs to Riverside Mall every 30 minutes.

Fares and Passes
Students ride free with a valid student ID. Visitors pay a fare of $1.50 per ride. Staff may buy a monthly pass for $20.

Policies
Bikes are allowed on the front racks, with a maximum of two bikes per bus. Lost items are held for 14 days at the Transit Office in the Ross Building. Service is suspended when wind speeds exceed 45 mph.

pages:
BIO 318 Laboratory Safety Procedures
Personal Protective Equipment
Safety goggles must be rated ANSI Z87.1. Nitrile gloves are required at all times. Lab coats are laundered weekly by Kessler Services.

Chemical Handling
Ethidium bromide may only be used in Bay 3. Any spill larger than 500 mL requires evacuating the room and calling extension 4410.

Grading and Conduct
The lab safety quiz is worth 5% of the course grade. A student with two safety violations is removed from the lab section.
